schema: eras: list of {from, to, close_local_time, documented_by, retrospective} giving, for IV observation dates in [from, to], the documented time at which that date's published close becomes available (local New York time), the archived source, and whether the value is a retrospective reconstruction. An IV observation is eligible for the return (t_(j-1), t_j] only if its availability time is no later than t_(j-1); a date outside every documented era is ineligible.
